snippet.title: Mavrix by Matt Jones - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017196

We're so excited to share the official gameplay trailer for MAVRIX, launching on PlayStation 5 on January 22nd. An authentic mountain bike game. Ride with friends in an epic open world, race to climb the global leaderboards and stomp huge tricks in slopestyle. See you on the mountain!

#ps5 #ps5games #mavrix
